summary: The PR adds get/set_antialiased methods to Text objects, addressing the issue of per-object antialiasing control. However, there are some minor issues related to documentation and potential behavioral changes.

issues.description: The note in the set_antialiased method documentation suggests that antialiasing will be determined by rcParams['text.antialiased'] and the parameter 'antialiased' will have no effect if the text contains math expressions. This behavior is not implemented in the current patch, which could lead to confusion.
There is a risk that the change might affect the rendering of text with math expressions, as the note in the set_antialiased method documentation suggests. This should be tested explicitly.

While the PR includes tests that pass, there are no specific tests added to verify the new functionality of setting/getting antialiasing on a per-text-object basis. Additional tests should be added to ensure the new feature works as expected.
The PR does not include an update to the release notes or any user-facing documentation to inform users about the new feature. Adding a note in the release notes would be beneficial.
